title: Remote Clutch Bleeder Bracket for Porsche 911 993
notes: Two STL files for a -3 AN bulkhead and 3/8-24 bleeder screw. Clutch-system proximity requires a safety review; exclude from initial fitment pilots. Confirm original licence and installation evidence before import. 2026-10-15: the original Thingiverse page (thing 5787387) was not read: www.thingiverse.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client, so permission for automated agents could not be established and the thing page was not requested. No Internet Archive capture of that page is indexed. The CC-BY-NC (no version) statement rests only on the secondary archive, so redistribution is set to unknown, as for every Renn 3D Parts record, until the licence is read on the original page.
